name: MindOn
name_zh: 灵启万物（深圳）科技有限公司
summary:
MindOn develops general-purpose robot intelligence intended to work across different physical platforms. Its model combines perception, reasoning and action, with training based on large-scale human data rather than a separate model for each individual task. The company presents this as a way to make robot deployment more adaptable across environments.

Its public demonstrations include practical household activities and logistics workflows involving multiple robots. The emphasis is therefore on the intelligence and coordination layer that allows different bodies to perform useful work. MindOn's stated direction connects learning from human behavior with the ability to transfer capabilities between robot platforms.
